description: Variations are alternative versions of a campaign's email, compared side by side on the editor's Canvas tab. They never change what the campaign sends until use_campaign_variation. Labels: V1, V2, ... for versions of the email, V2.1, V2.2, ... for branches of V2. Starts generating 1-4 variations with AI and returns them at once with status generating; it does not wait. Each takes its own direction planned from the prompt, so they differ; style sets how far they move. The source is the email's saved content, or parentVariationId (must be ready; the new ones are its branches). Poll list_campaign_variations or get_campaign_variation until each is ready or failed (usually under a minute). Variations succeed or fail independently; a retry is a new request that creates new variations. An email can have at most 8 generating at once; wait for them instead of retrying.

companyId.description: Company ID. If omitted, uses the currently selected company.

parentVariationId.description: Derive from this variation instead of the email.

prompt.description: Direction for the new versions, any language, up to 2000 characters. Name specific versions ("one formal, one playful") to get exactly those.

style.description: How far to move from the source: close edits it and keeps its style and structure; fresh writes each version anew with its own structure in the brand's colors and fonts; bold also gives each its own look (a theme of its own). Defaults to close for branches of a variation and fresh otherwise.
